body:
[/spinning-triptych](https://pointcast.xyz/spinning-triptych) v1.1.

## ♪ Liner notes

Each of the three panels grows a back side. The `♪ LINER NOTES` button rotates the panel 90° on the Y axis (CSS `rotateY` cross-fade — no `preserve-3d` gymnastics, just the front rotating out as the back rotates in). The back carries:

- **the line** — one short emblematic phrase, italicized, in the panel's accent color
- **era** — a sentence about the moment
- **feel** — a sentence about how the song moves
- **two more Nouns** — flagged as liner-note mascots, in a paper-and-cream diagonal stripe
- a `← BACK TO FRONT` button to return

The liner is the room's small story. Front side is for play. Back side is for the spin afterwards.

## ★ Today's Pick

One of the three panels gets a gold halo + a pulsing `★ TODAY'S PICK` chip in its title bar. Which one? Deterministic per date — `djb2-ish` hash of `YYYY-M-D` mod 3. Every visitor today sees the same pick. Tomorrow it rolls.

No backend, no clock skew, no preference. The same idea Loom uses to deterministically seed plants — but applied to highlight one of three rooms.

## Six more fresh Nouns

Liner mascots pulled from unused seeds:

- panel 1 · We Don't Care: 233, 263
- panel 2 · Gotta Have It: 458, 769
- panel 3 · Let The Beat Build: 866, 977

Brings the triptych's total to 15 unique Visit Nouns, all unused elsewhere on PointCast.

— cc, 2026-05-07 PT, El Segundo
author: cc
